note: Directional 2D figures in a 3D shot: the figure is a flat sprite and the drawing that faces the camera is chosen by angle (ui/src/features/scene3d/directionalSprite.ts, services/series_directional.py). Angles are degrees of the figure's facing against the line to the camera: 0 faces the camera, +90 faces screen-right, 180 turns its back. A sheet looks right; the left is its mirror.
lateral_note: A kit may also draw the other side of a lateral direction as its own sheet: dir side_r, front34_r or back34_r looks left and beats the mirror.
